startup_test.notes: Initial attempt without SDL dummy driver failed with 'Not enough memory resources' error. Running with SDL_VIDEODRIVER=dummy resolved the issue for headless environment.

basic_functionality_tests.details: Game class initialized successfully, pygame display created in dummy mode
Game loop executed for 120 seconds without crashing
PhysicsEngine initialized and integrated with game
Display, font, and UI components initialized

notes: Application requires graphical display for normal operation. In headless environments, SDL_VIDEODRIVER=dummy must be set.
Game is designed for both human play and AI agent interaction through step_ai() method.
conclusion: The Vector Brick Stacker Gravity Balance application starts successfully and runs stably in a headless environment using the SDL dummy video driver. All core components (game loop, physics, block spawning, UI) initialize correctly. The application is ready for both human gameplay and AI training.
